verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document versioning, review, or rollback of Portkey configs, prompts, or other automations. Related items, such as filtering logs by Config ID, canary or gradual model rollouts, and a prompt toolkit for "developing, testing, and deploying" prompts, are adjacent features. None of them shows version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
